leads.title: Constitution of Montenegro
leads.documents: Constitutional ban on same-sex marriage; basis for ineligibility of same-sex couples for marriage protections
leads.detail: Cited in Recognition of same-sex relationships section; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Law on Prohibition of Discrimination (Zakon o zabrani diskriminacije)
leads.documents: Bans discrimination on sexual orientation and gender identity in employment, goods/services, education and health; EU membership requirement
leads.detail: Passed 27 July 2010 by Montenegrin Parliament; definition quoted in text; no URL visible

leads.title: Official Gazette of Montenegro - Law on Life Partnership
leads.documents: Creates Life Partnership registration for same-sex couples since 15 July 2021 with almost same rights as marriage except adoption
leads.detail: Signed 3 July 2020 by President Milo Djukanovic; published 7 July 2020; entry into force 8th day after publication, applied from one year thereafter; no URL visible

leads.title: Criminal Code of Montenegro - 2013 amendments
leads.documents: Prohibits hate speech on sexual orientation and gender identity and provides penalty enhancements for LGBT-based crimes
leads.detail: Amendments adopted 2013, came into force 3 June 2014; no URL visible

leads.title: Government of Montenegro - partnership bill drafts
leads.documents: Government preparation and acceptance of registered partnership / Life Partnership drafts
leads.detail: Deputy PM Dusko Markovic statement 13 Nov 2012; Government accepted draft 27 Dec 2018; approved second draft 12 Dec 2019; introduced to parliament 24 Jan [2019] and 14 Jan 2020; no URL visible

leads.title: Parliament of Montenegro - votes and Human Rights Committee endorsements
leads.documents: Legislative history and enforcement machinery for partnership recognition
leads.detail: Committee backed 27 Feb 2019 and 18 June 2020; blocked 31 July 2019 in 38-4 vote with 39 abstentions (41 needed); approved 1 July 2020 in 42-5 vote with 34 abstentions; no URL visible

leads.title: Ministry for Human and Minority Rights - draft on registered partnerships
leads.documents: Draft bill to confer some marriage rights/benefits/responsibilities without adoption or fostering rights
leads.detail: Cited as drafter; opposed by Serbian Orthodox Church and Democratic Front; no URL visible

leads.title: ILGA-Europe ranking
leads.documents: Institutional assessment ranking Montenegro 8th out of 49 European countries on LGBT rights legislation
leads.detail: ILGA-Europe association cited in lede; no year/URL visible in text

leads.title: Balkan Insight - 2020 reporting
leads.documents: Social conditions and polling on acceptance: 71% considered homosexuality an 'illness', about half thought it danger to be suppressed
leads.detail: 2020 Balkan Insight noted despite civil partnerships bill; no URL visible

leads.title: LGBT Forum Progres / Queer Montenegro - Pride documentation
leads.documents: Documented incidents around Pride: first Gay Pride Budva 24 July 2013 with public reactions; Podgorica 20 Oct 2013 with violent anti-gay protesters arrested; fifth Podgorica Pride Sept 2017 with ~200 attendees and no recorded incident
leads.detail: NGO organizers named in LGBT activism section; no URL visible
